This reference maps generalized coordinates to named joints for the motor-driven
MuJoCo golf humanoids shipped in UpstreamDrift. Tables are generated from
vendored MJCF snapshots; they do not document MyoSuite muscle actuation or
Simscape export columns.

::: {.callout-note title="Authority Boundary"}
**This establishes** `qpos` / velocity index order, joint type, axis, limit, actuator
name, and closed-loop equality constraints for four MuJoCo golf XML definitions at a
pinned UpstreamDrift commit.

**This does not establish** `golfer-scapula/2.0` Simscape conventions, ISB anatomical
angle definitions, pose-estimator included angles, or hand-split grasp coordinates.
Those items remain open under [AffineDrift #5621](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/5621).
:::

## MuJoCo Motor-Driven Humanoids {#sec-mujoco-golf-maps}

Regenerate after changing the manifest pin:

```bash
python3 -m scripts.generate_golf_model_maps
```

{{< include _generated/golf-model-maps-mujoco.qmd >}}

## How to Read `q[i]` {#sec-reading-q}

Use the `qpos` index for configuration components and the `v` index for generalized
velocities. Motor actuators act on the listed hinge joints. `weld` and `connect`
equalities enforce grip closure and (in the advanced model) hip attachment without
adding independent coordinates; their forces depend on the MuJoCo solver.
